items.summary: Retain the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next revenue experiment after capacity release; create no duplicate request. Evidence baseline: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for the available 2026-09-21 window. Smallest reversible prototype: one-surface CTA hierarchy and adjacent disclosure refinement with unchanged destinations, no new tracking, routes, dependencies, credentials, permissions, or cross-site behavior. Metric: affiliate clicks plus destination integrity and accessibility acceptance; revenue and causal lift remain unknown. Time-to-learn: 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks. Require deterministic tests, build, link validation, smoke, keyboard/focus/contrast/tap-target checks, and single-diff rollback. Delivery remains capacity-gated at 10/10 slots.

After the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case is completed or justifiably closed with validation, rollback, release-boundary, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence, admit only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Do not create duplicate work. Acceptance: unchanged affiliate destinations, adjacent disclosure, responsive layout, visible keyboard focus, sufficient contrast and tap targets, no overflow or content loss, deterministic tests, build, links, smoke, and rollback evidence.

Do not adopt or prototype new GitHub capabilities this cycle. Evidence supports only deferred research: microsoft/markitdown is MIT-licensed, passed 8/8 bounded lab checks, and could support disposable owned-document-to-Markdown content discovery; shadcn-ui/ui is MIT-licensed and passed 3/3 checks for reusable accessible UI; mermaid-js/mermaid is MIT-licensed with supported SEO-content fit but no native checks. Risks remain fleet-specific security, dependency provenance, maintenance, integration, and measurable revenue impact; no dependencies were installed. Smallest future prototypes would be isolated fixture-based transformations or components, with success measured by content-production time, accessibility/build checks, and search or conversion outcomes. Time-to-learn is one bounded lab cycle per candidate. No queue admission or owner approval request is created.

Create no new CRO proposals, experiments, site-factory admissions, telemetry requests, or control-plane implementations this cycle. Existing records cover scheduler, measurement, AI-cost, retry, and admission concerns; delivery is saturated and active improvements await measurement. Preserve unknowns: Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21, while site revenue, ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unsupported. Keep launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged.
